preconditions.description: The number of notes is between 1 and 10^5.
The positions of notes on the keyboard are between 1 and 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.description: No finger is used twice consecutively.

postconditions.expression: There exists a sequence b_1, ..., b_n where each b_i is from 1 to 5
Output -1 if no convenient fingering exists
